options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to the issuer CA certificate, chain file (PEM or DER format), or bundle for signature verification.

options.name: checkend_value
options.description: Number of seconds to check for impending expiration used with validate_checkend.

options.name: common_name
options.description: Expected Common Name (CN) of the certificate subject.

options.name: content
options.description: Certificate content to verify. Can be provided as **base64-encoded string** or as **raw PEM/DER text**. If provided, this takes precedence over C(path). When providing raw PEM, it should include the C(-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----) and C(-----END CERTIFICATE-----) markers.

options.name: country
options.description: Expected Country (C) of the certificate subject.

options.name: email_address
options.description: Expected Email Address of the certificate subject.

options.name: extended_key_usage
options.description: List of Extended Key Usage (EKU) purpose OIDs / names that MUST all be present. Validation fails if the EKU extension is missing or any requested value is absent. Use the short names as commonly displayed E.g., serverAuth, clientAuth, etc..

options.name: issuer_ca_path
options.description: Deprecated. Use C(ca_path) instead. Path to the issuer CA certificate.

options.name: key_size
options.description: Expected key size in bits (e.g., 2048 for RSA/DSA, 256 for EC). Not applicable for Ed25519.

options.name: key_type
options.description: Expected public key algorithm (e.g., 'rsa', 'ec', 'dsa', 'ed25519'). Aliased to C(key_algo) for backward compatibility.

options.name: key_usage
options.description: List of expected Key Usage values that **must all** be present in the certificate. Validation fails if any value from this list is missing. Case sensitive — use exact names as defined in RFC 5280 / cryptography library.

options.name: locality
options.description: Expected Locality (L) of the certificate subject.

options.name: logging_level
options.description: Parameter used to define the level of troubleshooting output.

options.name: organization
options.description: Expected Organization (O) of the certificate subject.

options.name: organizational_unit
options.description: Expected Organizational Unit (OU) of the certificate subject.

options.name: path
options.description: Path to the certificate file to verify (PEM or DER format).

options.name: private_key_content
options.description: Private key content to verify against the certificate's public key. Can be provided as **base64-encoded string** or as **raw PEM text**. If provided, this takes precedence over C(private_key_path). When providing raw PEM, it should include the C(-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----) / C(-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----) markers.

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Private key password.

options.name: private_key_path
options.description: Path to the private key file to verify against the certificate's public key. If specified, performs a match test between the certificate's public key and the private key.

options.name: serial_number
options.description: Expected serial number of the certificate to verify against. Can be provided in **decimal** (e.g. '12345') or **hexadecimal** format. Hex format supports optional C(0x) prefix and colon separators E.g., '0x3039', '01:23:45:67', '01234567' The comparison is case-insensitive and ignores colons/spaces. Returned in C(details.serial_number) as lowercase hex with colon separators. E.g., '01:23:45:67:89:ab:cd:ef'), matching C(openssl x509 -serial) and C(community.crypto.x509_certificate_info)

options.name: signature_algorithm
options.description: Expected signature algorithm (e.g., 'sha256WithRSAEncryption').

options.name: state_or_province
options.description: Expected State or Province (ST) of the certificate subject.

options.name: subject_alt_names
options.description: List of expected Subject Alternative Names (SANs) to verify (DNS names only).

options.name: validate_checkend
options.description: Whether to check if the certificate expires within a specified time (seconds).

options.name: validate_expired
options.description: Whether to check if the certificate is expired.

options.name: validate_is_ca
options.description: Verify that the certificate is a CA certificate by checking basicConstraints for CA=TRUE.

options.name: validate_modulus_match
options.description:
Verify if the certificate's modulus matches the direct
    issuer's modulus. Only applies to RSA keys. Logic will handle setting this to True if ca_path is present default is true if ca_path is provided

options.name: version
options.description: Expected certificate version (1 or 3).
